title: Exception / Debug String Parsing (ERROR_STRING_PARSING)
pattern: An error handler reads or matches substring patterns inside raw exception or debug string outputs to dictate control flow.
why_bad: According to Hyrum's Law, once a debug string is matched, it becomes an accidental public API contract. Any optimization, localization, or formatting update to the error message will silently break client-side execution, forcing developers to freeze internal diagnostics.
detection: Look for substring matching methods (such as `.contains()`, `.starts_with()`, or string-based regexes) applied directly to errors, debug logs, or stack trace strings.
fix: Model errors as structured enums or exception class variants, segregating the machine-readable error payload from human-readable diagnostic display representations.
source: *Benjamin C. Pierce - Types and Programming Languages (2002)*, Chapter 14; *Titus Winters et al. - Software Engineering at Google (2020)*, Chapter 1 (Hyrum's Law).
